_doc: Judge label corrections. judge_v31.json stays untouched (frozen baseline); these amendments are applied on top via eval_gold_set.py --amendments, and flag_quality is always reported both raw and amended. amended=supported_by_eee_only means: the field value was deterministically verified against the benchmark's EEE artifact on disk, which the judge's source bundle (docling+html+readme+RAG) did not include -- the value is faithful to a pipeline input source, but only to EEE evaluation data, not to the benchmark's own publication (trust hierarchy paper > hf > eee stays visible).

aa-lcr:methodology.baseline_results.reason: All five listed models and scores match EEE evaluation_summary.top_performers exactly (mistral-small-latest 0.712, kimi-k2.5 0.7, qwen3.5-397b-a17b 0.687, Qwen3.6 Plus 0.683, qwen3.5-122b-a10b 0.669), mean 0.5695 +/- 0.1958 over 13 models also present. Judge source bundle contained no EEE data; aa-lcr has no paper (truth: leaderboard-only).

attaq:methodology.baseline_results.reason: Score range 0.861-0.885 across three models matches the EEE artifact (exactly 3 model entries). The field itself states the original paper reports no baseline results; EEE is the only source carrying this information.

api-bank:methodology.interpretation.reason: Claim restates EEE metric_configs: 'lower_is_better': false under key llm_stats.api-bank.score, both present verbatim in the EEE artifact. Judge source bundle contained no EEE data (judge note itself says the config 'does NOT appear anywhere in the source text').

aider-polyglot:methodology.interpretatio.reason: The 'fabricated' statistics mean 0.6213 and std 0.1524 are present verbatim in the EEE artifact (evaluation_summary), as are mean/std keys; aider-polyglot has no paper (truth: leaderboard-only). Judge saw only docling/html/readme.

bold:methodology.interpretation.reason: The metric key 'openeval.bold.logprob' and 'lower_is_better' are present verbatim in the EEE artifact; judge grep over docling/html/readme could not see them.

chexpert-cxr:methodology.calculation.reason: Claim restates EEE metric_config for llm_stats.chexpert-cxr.score: 'lower_is_better': false (= higher is better) and 'score_type': 'continuous', both present verbatim in the EEE artifact. Judge source bundle contained no EEE data.
